extracted.intended_audience: public service media organisations, journalists, member organisations, policymakers, and potential members
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the Public Media Alliance's mission, membership eligibility, core values and functions of public service media, and the activities PMA undertakes to support, defend, and build capacity in public service media worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision for public media accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Our vision is a world where the public can continue to access free, independent, engaging and representative national and international media wherever they are.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This vision underpins the Alliance's work to support members, improve standards, and facilitate exchange; implies that PSM should be free to access, independent in governance and editorial, engaging in content, and representative of society.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core values of public service media
rubrics_metrics.description: These fundamental values underpin informed democracy and allow public media organisations to hold power to account: editorial independence, accuracy, transparency, impartiality, independent regulation, diversity, and universality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values are tied to public funding (tax or licence fee) and should shield content from political, partisan, or commercial influence; they form the normative standard by which PSM legitimacy and quality are judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core function of public service media
rubrics_metrics.description: Support an informed, connected and engaged electorate by providing trusted verified news and current affairs, free of political, partisan, or commercial influences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises trust and verification as central to PSM output; programming and news should prioritize public interest over partisan or commercial agendas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership eligibility and inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Full and equal membership is open to public service broadcasters (PSBs) and public service media (PSMs) from any country; commercial companies with a PSB commitment may join as affiliates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflects historical change from Commonwealth-only membership to a global, inclusive membership model; membership implies commitment to PSM values and exchange of best practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy on behalf of public media
rubrics_metrics.description: We write statements, letters, & submissions reflecting the value and importance of independent public service media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PMA's advocacy role includes promoting press freedom, responding to threats like media capture and political interference, and acting as a collective voice for members in international fora.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for members facing pressure
rubrics_metrics.description: We support and work with organisations to improve standards, train journalists, and provide support if they face pressure from governments, funding issues or attacks on their reporters and staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical support can include legal/political advocacy, assistance during attacks on staff, and interventions to protect editorial independence and safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity building: training, mentoring and exchanges
rubrics_metrics.description: We organise workshops, mentorships, and international exchanges to allow members to learn from one another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capacity-building activities include training journalists, facilitating knowledge and travel exchanges, roundtables and workshops aimed at improving standards and skills across member organisations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events and networking
rubrics_metrics.description: We run roundtables and workshops for our members, and also partner on international events, acting as a strong voice for PSM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Events provide opportunities for staff from member organisations to connect, share approaches, and develop partnerships; PMA also participates in international committees and conferences (e.g., MFC Consultative Network, Global Task Force, PBI Steering Committee).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and reporting on sector trends and threats
rubrics_metrics.description: We report on the most pressing threats facing public service media, as well as spotlight innovations and trends across the industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PMA provides research on PSM trends and partners with academic institutions; reporting serves to inform advocacy, share best practice, and document risks like disinformation and media capture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project-based media development
rubrics_metrics.description: We run media development projects on a range of subjects, across the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects are tailored interventions to support member development, address sector challenges, and pilot innovations; they form part of PMA's practical support toolkit.
